Role of age and sex in the incidence of adverse effects among diabetic patients treated with glipizide. Glipizide is an antidiabetic drug that belongs to a class of medication known as sulfonylureas. It is considered one of the highly prescribed antidiabetic drugs for the treatment of type II diabetes in patients following a kidney transplant.
